verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Light Grenade (Super) as a Ki Blast Super, projectile/button-mash/long-range, costing 100 Ki and chargeable to three stages.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Piccolo training is the documented acquisition route. Current and historical references also document later Partner Customization availability for Adult Gohan and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed).
verification_audit.variant_policy: The Super and Ultimate variants are kept as separate identities. Light Grenade (Ultimate) is an unavailable-for-CaC 300-Ki Ultimate used by Piccolo (Power Awakening), so it is not merged into this Super record.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: No Ultimate Finish requirement is asserted. The evidence establishes instructor training rather than a PQ reward condition, but does not independently provide a negative-UF statement, so the field remains null.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages are not promoted as canonical because version stability is not established.

records.name: Light Grenade
records.character_source: Piccolo, Gohan (Adult), and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) customizable partners
records.skill_description: A long-range Ki Blast Super that is charged by repeatedly pressing the input, reaching three stages with different hit behavior.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material describes three charge stages. Stage 1 causes minor hitstun, Stage 2 restands and stuns a juggled opponent, and Stage 3 knocks the opponent back. Higher stages take longer to fire and require greater knockback to connect reliably. Historical/current references document Adult Gohan and Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) Partner Customization availability after purchasing the skill.
records.combo_notes: Stage 1 can add damage after shorter knockbacks. Stages 2 and 3 can be used after longer knockbacks; Stage 2's restand property can enable a new combo sequence.
